original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: wif_template.jinja

resources:
- name: github-actions-wif
  type: wif_template.jinja
  properties:
    projectId: my-gcp-project-id
    projectNumber: '123456789012'
    poolId: github-actions-pool
    poolDisplayName: GitHub Actions Pool
    poolDescription: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions
    providerId: github-provider
    providerDisplayName: GitHub Provider
    githubOrg: my-github-org
    githubRepo: my-repo
    githubRef: refs/heads/main
    serviceAccountId: github-actions-cloud-run-deployer
    serviceAccountDisplayName: GitHub Actions Cloud Run Deployer
    region: us-central1

outputs:
- name: workloadIdentityPoolName
  value: $(ref.github-actions-wif.workloadIdentityPoolName)
- name: workloadIdentityProviderName
  value: $(ref.github-actions-wif.workloadIdentityProviderName)
- name: serviceAccountEmail
  value: $(ref.github-actions-wif.serviceAccountEmail)

---
# wif_template.jinja
{% set projectId = properties['projectId'] %}
{% set projectNumber = properties['projectNumber'] %}
{% set poolId = properties['poolId'] %}
{% set providerId = properties['providerId'] %}
{% set githubOrg = properties['githubOrg'] %}
{% set githubRepo = properties['githubRepo'] %}
{% set githubRef = properties['githubRef'] %}
{% set serviceAccountId = properties['serviceAccountId'] %}
{% set saEmail = serviceAccountId + '@' + projectId + '.iam.gserviceaccount.com' %}

resources:

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-wif-pool
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ projectId }}/locations/global
    workloadIdentityPoolId: {{ poolId }}
    workloadIdentityPool:
      displayName: {{ properties['poolDisplayName'] }}
      description: {{ properties['poolDescription'] }}
      disabled: false

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-wif-provider
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ projectId }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: {{ providerId }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProvider:
      displayName: {{ properties['providerDisplayName'] }}
      disabled: false
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.aud: assertion.aud
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
        attribute.ref: assertion.ref
        attribute.workflow: assertion.workflow
      attributeCondition: "assertion.repository_owner == '{{ githubOrg }}'"
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
        allowedAudiences:
        - https://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ projectNumber }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}/providers/{{ providerId }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ env['deployment'] }}-wif-pool

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-deployer-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    accountId: {{ serviceAccountId }}
    projectId: {{ projectId }}
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: {{ properties['serviceAccountDisplayName'] }}
      description: Service account used by GitHub Actions to deploy Cloud Run services

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-sa-wif-binding
  action: gcp-types/iam-v1:iam.projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ projectId }}/serviceAccounts/{{ saEmail }}
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
        members:
        - principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ projectNumber }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}/attribute.repository/{{ githubOrg }}/{{ githubRepo }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ env['deployment'] }}-deployer-sa
    - {{ env['deployment'] }}-wif-provider

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-run-admin-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ projectId }}
    role: roles/run.admin
    member: serviceAccount:{{ saEmail }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ env['deployment'] }}-deployer-sa

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-sa-user-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ projectId }}
    role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
    member: serviceAccount:{{ saEmail }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ env['deployment'] }}-deployer-sa

- name: {{ env['deployment'] }}-ar-writer-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{
